legacy_bootcmd: mmc dev 0; load mmc 0:1 ${kernel_addr_r} Image; load mmc 0:1 ${fdt_addr_r} system.dtb; load mmc 0:1 ${ramdisk_addr_r} ramdisk.cpio.gz.u-boot; setenv bootargs "console=ttyPS0,115200 earlycon"; booti ${kernel_addr_r} ${ramdisk_addr_r} ${fdt_addr_r}
trial_bootcmd: mmc dev 0; if load mmc 0:1 0x18000000 /daphne14-trial-20261020/Image; then if load mmc 0:1 0x40000000 /daphne14-trial-20261020/system.dtb; then setenv bootargs earlycon console=ttyPS1,115200 root=/dev/mmcblk0p3 rootwait rw; booti 0x18000000 - 0x40000000; fi; fi
rollback_at_uboot: setenv bootcmd run daphne14_legacy_bootcmd; saveenv; reset
boot_firmware: Existing 2024.1 QSPI firmware retained; only its environment will be saved.
